scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Health Insurance Scheme - Nagaland
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent or indigenous resident of Nagaland
For CMHIS (EP) the applicant must be a government employee, pensioner, or dependent family member
For CMHIS (GC) the applicant must be an Indigenous Inhabitant or Permanent Resident not covered under AB PM‑JAY
Certificates for dependents are required for EP applicants
Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate (IIC) or Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) issued after 2016 is required for GC applicants
Aadhaar card and a valid mobile number are required
benefits_summary: Provides cashless hospitalisation up to ₹20 lakhs for employees/pensioners and ₹5 lakhs for general residents, covering inpatient and select daycare procedures across empanelled hospitals.
